svg.text: If OpenViking times out or is unavailable, the message goes out without memory and does not get it later.
Tool steps skip step 3; sub-agent calls, title generation and other housekeeping requests skip steps 3 and 5.
Why replay: providers cache prompts by prefix
Cache hit, billed at the cached rate
Full price from last turn's memory onward
The client's history never contains what the gateway added, so the gateway keeps its own record and puts it back on every request.
Without replay, each turn is recomputed from where memory was added in the previous turn; the exact cost depends on the provider's cache breakpoints.
Across turns: save the conversation, extract memories
Regenerated or abandoned answers are never saved.
The last turn is saved after 10 quiet minutes.
Text before the cut is no longer sent; the client's history stays as it is.
Compaction costs one extra model request.
